reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Patient-paired multiomic treatment-associated program discovery, assay-specific preprocessing, primary late integration/enrichment and locked external cohort validation.

checks.reason: No explicit pre-execution plan to consult original assay Methods, supplements or validated analysis protocols and check their transfer to the present inputs.

checks.quote: Normalize RNA using an approach appropriate
checks.reason: No concrete platform-conditional transformation/normalization procedure or executable calibration-to-choice rule for the computational inputs.
Assay QC/reference types are enumerated but no quantitative reference-to-acceptance calibration procedure and failure action are operational.
The patient unit is correct, but no nuisance-variance-to-precision/detectable-effect calculation justifies the fixed 30-patient and external sample size.

checks.quote: an inferential test appropriate to cohort size
checks.reason: The external primary test and interval method remain unspecified; the illustrative paired models do not settle this inferential choice or its assumptions.
No bounded complexity/feature/weight parameter exploration with a range-derivation and stop rule before confirmation.
Failed validation triggers diagnostics and prohibits retrospective signature changes, but revised analyses are not explicitly refrozen for fresh independent confirmation.
Version control and raw data retention are useful but input hashes, pinned computational environment and exact execution commands are missing.

checks.quote: standardize features within modality using development-set parameters
checks.reason: Nested resampling is mentioned but fitted transformations/filtering are not explicitly recomputed inside each training fold. Whole-development scaling can leak held-out patient information into internal evaluation.

Informative missingness is named, but comparison to complete cases does not test plausible non-random observation mechanisms. No MAR assumption or explicit MNAR sensitivity/bounding scenario is operational.
No clean-environment rerun, declared numerical output tolerances, resource/failure logs or source-difference audit for target plots/tables.

Useful patient-paired RNA/protein-first analysis with a batch-confounding gate, identity checks, calibrated association language and guarded external validation. Enrichment and late integration have distinct roles and missing modality scores are acknowledged. Internal preprocessing boundaries and informative-missingness sensitivity remain underdeveloped.
